provenance_notes: All CIs are sentence-cluster percentile bootstrap, B = 2000, seed 0, as computed by the source experiments.
The draft specification listed the judge at 0.551 (L20) and 0.515 (L25); the run's analysis file gives 0.6145 and 0.6427. The file values are plotted.
Consensus in the Long-rules group is c_score_sig, which equals c_score_align under the shared-signature (SIG) condition.

Source files are in the published repository under round-5/experiment-14/src/inputs_copy/iter_3/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_6/results/analysis_T1.json and round-3/experiment-7/src/results/analysis.json.
